input.text:
2024 BMO Round 1 第5题。题目：p 是素数，n 是满足 n>1 且 p | (n^6−1) 的最小正整数。证明 p | ((n+1)^6−1) 或 p | ((n+2)^6−1)。

证明：
由恒等式 t^6−1=(t−1)(t+1)(t²+t+1)(t²−t+1)，以及 p 为素数且 p|(n^6−1)，p 必整除这四个因子中的至少一个。逐一讨论。
情形一，p|(n²+n+1)。则模 p 有 n+1≡−n²，所以 (n+1)^6≡n^12≡(n^6)^2≡1。因此 p|((n+1)^6−1)。
情形二，p|(n+1)。则 n+2≡1 (mod p)，所以 (n+2)^6≡1，故 p|((n+2)^6−1)。
情形三，p|(n−1)。则 n≡1 (mod p)，故 n−2≡−1 (mod p)，从而 (n−2)^6≡1 (mod p)。若 n≥4，则 n−2>1 且 n−2<n，这与 n 的最小性矛盾。因此此情形只能有 n=2 或 n=3；但 n=2 时 p|1 不可能，故 n=3。此时 p|(n−1)=2，故 p=2；而 (n+2)^6−1=5^6−1 为偶数，结论成立。
情形四，p|(n²−n+1)。则 n−1≡n² (mod p)，因此 (n−1)^6≡n^12≡1 (mod p)。若 n≥3，则 1<n−1<n，违反最小性，所以 n=2。此时 p|(2²−2+1)=3，即 p=3，且 (n+2)^6−1=4^6−1=4095 可被3整除。
以上四种情形穷尽所有可能，故断言成立。

  intro p n hp hn hdiv hmin
  have hfac : n ^ 6 - 1 = (n ^ 2 + n + 1) * (n + 1) * (n - 1) * (n ^ 2 - n + 1) := by
    have h1 : 1 ≤ n ^ 6 := by
      have hpos : 0 < n ^ 6 := pow_pos (by omega : 0 < n) 6
      omega
    have h2 : 1 ≤ n := by omega
    have h3 : n ≤ n ^ 2 := by
      calc
        n = n * 1 := by rw [Nat.mul_one]
        _ ≤ n * n := Nat.mul_le_mul_left n (by omega : 1 ≤ n)
        _ = n ^ 2 := by rw [pow_two]
    have hfacZ : ((n ^ 6 - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) =
        (((n ^ 2 + n + 1) * (n + 1) * (n - 1) * (n ^ 2 - n + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub h1]
      simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_one]
      rw [Nat.cast_sub h2, Nat.cast_sub h3]
      ring
    exact Nat.cast_injective hfacZ
  have source_step_0 : p ∣ (n ^ 2 + n + 1) ∨ p ∣ (n + 1) ∨ p ∣ (n - 1) ∨ p ∣ (n ^ 2 - n + 1) := by
    rw [hfac] at hdiv
    rcases hp.dvd_mul.mp hdiv with h | hD
    · rcases hp.dvd_mul.mp h with hAB | hC
      · rcases hp.dvd_mul.mp hAB with hA | hB
        · exact Or.inl hA
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inl hB)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl hC))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr hD))
  have source_step_12 : p ∣ ((n + 1) ^ 6 - 1) ∨ p ∣ ((n + 2) ^ 6 - 1) := by
    rcases source_step_0 with hcase1 | hcase2 | hcase3 | hcase4
    · have hzero : (n : ZMod p) ^ 2 + (n : ZMod p) + 1 = 0 := by
        have hcast : ((n ^ 2 + n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 0 :=
          (ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd).mpr hcase1
        simpa [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_one, add_assoc] using hcast
      have hcube : (n : ZMod p) ^ 3 = 1 := by
        have hdiff : (n : ZMod p) ^ 3 - 1 =
            ((n : ZMod p) - 1) * ((n : ZMod p) ^ 2 + (n : ZMod p) + 1) := by ring
        rw [hzero, mul_zero] at hdiff
        exact sub_eq_zero.mp hdiff
      have hpow6_n : (n : ZMod p) ^ 6 = 1 := by
        calc
          (n : ZMod p) ^ 6 = ((n : ZMod p) ^ 3) ^ 2 := by ring
          _ = (1 : ZMod p) ^ 2 := by rw [hcube]
          _ = 1 := by ring
      have source_step_1 : (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ^ 6 = 1) := by
        have hrel : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = - (n : ZMod p) ^ 2 := by
          calc
            ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = (n : ZMod p) + 1 := by
              rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
            _ = - (n : ZMod p) ^ 2 + ((n : ZMod p) ^ 2 + (n : ZMod p) + 1) := by ring
            _ = - (n : ZMod p) ^ 2 + 0 := by rw [hzero]
            _ = - (n : ZMod p) ^ 2 := by ring
        calc
          (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ^ 6) = (- (n : ZMod p) ^ 2) ^ 6 := by rw [hrel]
          _ = ((n : ZMod p) ^ 6) ^ 2 := by ring
          _ = (1 : ZMod p) ^ 2 := by rw [hpow6_n]
          _ = 1 := by ring
      have source_step_2 : p ∣ ((n + 1) ^ 6 - 1) := by
        have hge : 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ 6 := by
          have hpos : 0 < (n + 1) ^ 6 := pow_pos (by omega : 0 < n + 1) 6
          omega
        have hcast : ((((n + 1) ^ 6 - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p)) = 0 := by
          rw [Nat.cast_sub hge, Nat.cast_pow]
          rw [source_step_1]
          norm_num
        exact (ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd).mp hcast
      exact Or.inl source_step_2
    · have hzero : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 0 :=
        (ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd).mpr hcase2
      have source_step_3 : (((n + 2 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ^ 6 = 1) := by
        have hcast : ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) + 1 := by
          rw [show n + 2 = (n + 1) + 1 by omega]
          rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
        have hrel : ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 1 := by
          rw [hcast, hzero]
          ring
        rw [hrel]
        norm_num
      have source_step_4 : p ∣ ((n + 2) ^ 6 - 1) := by
        have hge : 1 ≤ (n + 2) ^ 6 := by
          have hpos : 0 < (n + 2) ^ 6 := pow_pos (by omega : 0 < n + 2) 6
          omega
        have hcast : ((((n + 2) ^ 6 - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p)) = 0 := by
          rw [Nat.cast_sub hge, Nat.cast_pow]
          rw [source_step_3]
          norm_num
        exact (ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd).mp hcast
      exact Or.inr source_step_4
    · have hzero1 : ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 0 :=
        (ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd).mpr hcase3
      have hcastsub1 : ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = (n : ZMod p) - 1 := by
        rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ n)]
        norm_num
      have hn_eq_one : (n : ZMod p) = 1 := by
        have hsub : (n : ZMod p) - 1 = 0 := by
          rw [← hcastsub1]
          exact hzero1
        exact sub_eq_zero.mp hsub
      have source_step_5 : (((n - 2 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ^ 6 = 1) := by
        by_cases hn2 : n = 2
        · exfalso
          have hp_dvd_one : p ∣ 1 := by
            simpa [hn2] using hcase3
          have hp_eq_one : p = 1 := Nat.dvd_one.mp hp_dvd_one
          have hpgt1 : 1 < p := hp.one_lt
          omega
        · have hn2le : 2 ≤ n := by omega
          have hcastsub2 : ((n - 2 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = (n : ZMod p) - 2 := by
            rw [Nat.cast_sub hn2le]
            norm_num
          have hrel : ((n - 2 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = -1 := by
            rw [hcastsub2, hn_eq_one]
            norm_num
          rw [hrel]
          norm_num
      have source_step_6 : ¬ 4 ≤ n := by
        intro hn4
        have hm_gt : 1 < n - 2 := by omega
        have hm_lt : n - 2 < n := by omega
        have hm_div : p ∣ ((n - 2) ^ 6 - 1) := by
          have hpos : 0 < n - 2 := by omega
          have hge : 1 ≤ (n - 2) ^ 6 := by
            have hpowpos : 0 < (n - 2) ^ 6 := pow_pos hpos 6
            omega
          have hcast : ((((n - 2) ^ 6 - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p)) = 0 := by
            rw [Nat.cast_sub hge, Nat.cast_pow]
            rw [source_step_5]
            norm_num
          exact (ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd).mp hcast
        exact hmin (n - 2) hm_gt hm_lt hm_div
      have source_step_7 : n = 3 := by
        have hnle : n ≤ 3 := by omega
        have hn_ne2 : n ≠ 2 := by
          intro hn2
          have hp_dvd_one : p ∣ 1 := by
            simpa [hn2] using hcase3
          have hp_eq_one : p = 1 := Nat.dvd_one.mp hp_dvd_one
          have hpgt1 : 1 < p := hp.one_lt
          omega
        omega
      have source_step_8 : p ∣ ((n + 2) ^ 6 - 1) := by
        have hp_dvd_two : p ∣ 2 := by
          simpa [source_step_7] using hcase3
        have hp_eq_two : p = 2 := by
          have hp_le_two : p ≤ 2 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num) hp_dvd_two
          have hpgt1 : 1 < p := hp.one_lt
          omega
        rw [source_step_7, hp_eq_two]
        norm_num
      exact Or.inr source_step_8
    · have hnle : n ≤ n ^ 2 := by
        calc
          n = n * 1 := by rw [Nat.mul_one]
          _ ≤ n * n := Nat.mul_le_mul_left n (by omega : 1 ≤ n)
          _ = n ^ 2 := by rw [pow_two]
      have hsub_cast : ((n ^ 2 - n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) =
          (n : ZMod p) ^ 2 - (n : ZMod p) + 1 := by
        calc
          ((n ^ 2 - n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = ((n ^ 2 - n : ℕ) : ZMod p) + 1 := by
            rw [Nat.cast_add]
            norm_num
          _ = ((n : ZMod p) ^ 2 - (n : ZMod p)) + 1 := by
            rw [Nat.cast_sub hnle, Nat.cast_pow]
          _ = (n : ZMod p) ^ 2 - (n : ZMod p) + 1 := by ring
      have hzero : (n : ZMod p) ^ 2 - (n : ZMod p) + 1 = 0 := by
        have hcast : ((n ^ 2 - n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 0 :=
          (ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd).mpr hcase4
        rw [hsub_cast] at hcast
        exact hcast
      have hrel : (n : ZMod p) ^ 2 = (n : ZMod p) - 1 := by
        calc
          (n : ZMod p) ^ 2 = ((n : ZMod p) ^ 2 - (n : ZMod p) + 1) + ((n : ZMod p) - 1) := by ring
          _ = 0 + ((n : ZMod p) - 1) := by rw [hzero]
          _ = (n : ZMod p) - 1 := by ring
      have hcube : (n : ZMod p) ^ 3 = -1 := by
        calc
          (n : ZMod p) ^ 3 = (n : ZMod p) * ((n : ZMod p) ^ 2) := by ring
          _ = (n : ZMod p) * ((n : ZMod p) - 1) := by rw [hrel]
          _ = (n : ZMod p) ^ 2 - (n : ZMod p) := by ring
          _ = ((n : ZMod p) - 1) - (n : ZMod p) := by rw [hrel]
          _ = -1 := by ring
      have hpow6_n : (n : ZMod p) ^ 6 = 1 := by
        calc
          (n : ZMod p) ^ 6 = ((n : ZMod p) ^ 3) ^ 2 := by ring
          _ = (-1 : ZMod p) ^ 2 := by rw [hcube]
          _ = 1 := by ring
      have hcastsub1 : ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = (n : ZMod p) - 1 := by
        rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ n)]
        norm_num
      have hsub_eq : ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = (n : ZMod p) ^ 2 := by
        rw [hcastsub1]
        exact hrel.symm
      have source_step_9 : (((n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ^ 6 = 1) := by
        rw [hsub_eq]
        calc
          (((n : ZMod p) ^ 2) ^ 6) = (n : ZMod p) ^ 12 := by ring
          _ = ((n : ZMod p) ^ 6) ^ 2 := by ring
          _ = (1 : ZMod p) ^ 2 := by rw [hpow6_n]
          _ = 1 := by ring
      have source_step_10 : n = 2 := by
        by_contra hne
        have hn3 : 3 ≤ n := by omega
        have hm_gt : 1 < n - 1 := by omega
        have hm_lt : n - 1 < n := by omega
        have hm_div : p ∣ ((n - 1) ^ 6 - 1) := by
          have hpos : 0 < n - 1 := by omega
          have hge : 1 ≤ (n - 1) ^ 6 := by
            have hpowpos : 0 < (n - 1) ^ 6 := pow_pos hpos 6
            omega
          have hcast : ((((n - 1) ^ 6 - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p)) = 0 := by
            rw [Nat.cast_sub hge, Nat.cast_pow]
            rw [source_step_9]
            norm_num
          exact (ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd).mp hcast
        exact hmin (n - 1) hm_gt hm_lt hm_div
      have source_step_11 : p ∣ ((n + 2) ^ 6 - 1) := by
        have hp_dvd_three : p ∣ 3 := by
          have h4' : p ∣ (2 ^ 2 - 2 + 1 : ℕ) := by
            simpa [source_step_10] using hcase4
          norm_num at h4'
          exact h4'
        have hp_eq_three : p = 3 := by
          have hp_le_three : p ≤ 3 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num) hp_dvd_three
          have hp_ne_two : p ≠ 2 := by
            intro hp2
            have h23 : (2 : ℕ) ∣ 3 := by
              simpa [hp2] using hp_dvd_three
            have hnot : ¬ ((2 : ℕ) ∣ 3) := by norm_num
            exact hnot h23
          have hp_eq_or : p = 2 ∨ p = 3 := by omega
          rcases hp_eq_or with hp2 | hp3
          · exfalso
            exact hp_ne_two hp2
          · exact hp3
        rw [source_step_10, hp_eq_three]
        norm_num
      exact Or.inr source_step_11
  exact source_step_12

2024 BMO Round 1 第5题。题目：p 是素数，n 是满足 n>1 且 p | (n^6−1) 的最小正整数。证明 p | ((n+1)^6−1) 或 p | ((n+2)^6−1)。

证明：
由恒等式 t^6−1=(t−1)(t+1)(t²+t+1)(t²−t+1)，以及 p 为素数且 p|(n^6−1)，p 必整除这四个因子中的至少一个。逐一讨论。
情形一，p|(n²+n+1)。则模 p 有 n+1≡−n²，所以 (n+1)^6≡n^12≡(n^6)^2≡1。因此 p|((n+1)^6−1)。
情形二，p|(n+1)。则 n+2≡1 (mod p)，所以 (n+2)^6≡1，故 p|((n+2)^6−1)。
情形三，p|(n−1)。则 n≡1 (mod p)，故 n−2≡−1 (mod p)，从而 (n−2)^6≡1 (mod p)。若 n≥4，则 n−2>1 且 n−2<n，这与 n 的最小性矛盾。因此此情形只能有 n=2 或 n=3；但 n=2 时 p|1 不可能，故 n=3。此时 p|(n−1)=2，故 p=2；而 (n+2)^6−1=5^6−1 为偶数，结论成立。
情形四，p|(n²−n+1)。则 n−1≡n² (mod p)，因此 (n−1)^6≡n^12≡1 (mod p)。若 n≥3，则 1<n−1<n，违反最小性，所以 n=2。此时 p|(2²−2+1)=3，即 p=3，且 (n+2)^6−1=4^6−1=4095 可被3整除。
以上四种情形穷尽所有可能，故断言成立。
